types.name: Domain
types.description: An ENS domain name

fields.name: isMigrated
fields.description: Whether this domain has been migrated to V2

fields.name: isReachable
fields.description:
Whether this domain is reachable via canonical top-down resolution.
  False when an ancestor label's subregistry pointer has moved away from
  the subregistry contract that originally minted this domain (orphaned
  subtree), when the domain has been LabelUnregistered, or when an
  ancestor expiry has passed. Default GraphQL queries filter
  `isReachable: true` — pass `where: { includeUnreachable: true }` to
  include orphans.

fields.name: unreachableSince
fields.description: Timestamp when this domain first became unreachable (null while reachable)

fields.name: tokenId
fields.description: ERC-721 token ID for this domain

fields.name: normalizedName
fields.description: ENSIP-15 normalized name (null if normalization fails)

fields.name: isNormalized
fields.description: Whether the name passes ENSIP-15 normalization (computed at query time)

fields.name: subdomainsCount
fields.description: Count of direct subdomains (one level only)

fields.name: eventsCount
fields.description: Count of events associated with this domain

types.name: Account
types.description: An Ethereum account (address)

types.name: CoinAddress
types.description: A coin address record with coin type (SLIP-44)

fields.name: coinType
fields.description: SLIP-44 coin type (e.g., 60 for ETH, 0 for BTC, 501 for SOL)

fields.name: address
fields.description: Address value for this coin type

types.name: Pubkey
types.description: A public key record (secp256k1 coordinates)

types.name: InterfaceRecord
types.description: An interface implementation record

types.name: Alias
types.description: A resolver alias mapping (from OwnedResolver)

types.name: Resolver
types.description: A resolver contract for an ENS domain

fields.name: addr
fields.description: Address record for a specific coin type (default: 60 for ETH)

fields.name: addresses
fields.description: All set addresses across all coin types

fields.name: texts
fields.description:
All text-record keys set on this resolver/name. This is a list of scalar
  strings (the keys only), NOT a list of {key, value} entities — the ENS
  subgraph's `texts` field has the same name but a different shape, so a
  subgraph-style `texts { key value }` selection will fail. To read values,
  call `text(key: "...")` per key.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Get a specific text record value by key (returns null if unset).

fields.name: abis
fields.description:
ABI content types set on this resolver. List of scalar integers (the
  contentType bitmasks only), not a list of entities — `abis { ... }` with
  a subselection will fail.

fields.name: interfaces
fields.description: Interface implementations set on this resolver

fields.name: aliases
fields.description: Aliases set on this resolver (from AliasChanged events)

types.name: Registration
types.description: A domain registration record

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: Chain where registration occurred (v1 or v2)

types.name: Event

fields.name: domain

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: Chain where event occurred (v1 or v2)

fields.name: data
fields.description: Event-specific data as JSON (e.g., key/value for TextChanged, address for AddressChanged)

inputFields.name: subdomainCount_lt

inputFields.name: expiry_gt
inputFields.description: Filter by expiry date greater than (Unix timestamp)

inputFields.name: expiry_gte
inputFields.description: Filter by expiry date greater than or equal (Unix timestamp)

inputFields.name: expiry_lt

inputFields.name: includeUnreachable
inputFields.description:
Include domains that are unreachable via canonical resolution

  ancestors). Default false — set true for audit / debug queries.

types.name: RegistryInfo
types.description: Registry information

fields.name: owner
fields.description:
Registry admin (the account holding the full root-role bitmap on this
  contract, i.e. resource=0x0 / role_bitmap=0x111…111). Returns the most
  recently granted admin if multiple, or null if no root role has been
  granted yet.
